final: WITH lines AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId AS inv, c.Company AS company, il.UnitPrice AS up FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId), grp AS (SELECT inv, company, AVG(up) AS avg_up, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lines GROUP BY inv, company), tot AS (SELECT SUM(line_count) AS total FROM grp), shares AS (SELECT g.company, g.avg_up, g.line_count, CAST(g.line_count AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM grp g JOIN tot t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), comp AS (SELECT company, AVG(avg_up) AS c_avg_up, SUM(line_count) AS c_lines, AVG(share) AS c_share FROM shares GROUP BY company) SELECT AVG(c_avg_up), AVG(c_lines), AVG(c_share) FROM comp
